thread.title: Lumentum Expects Strong 3D Sensor Growth, What It Means For Apple

author: REINHARDT KRAUSE
title: Lumentum Expects Strong 3D Sensor Growth, What It Means For Apple
text:
Lumentum Holdings ( LITE ) rocketed Tuesday after the maker of optical communications components reported adjusted fiscal second-quarter revenue and earnings that topped views and forecast 3D sensor shipments for late 2018 that one observer says bode well for Apple ( AAPL ) iPhone sales.
X Lumentum has pushed into a new market, 3D sensor devices for smartphones, with Apple a top customer. The stock has been pressured by disappointing sales of the iPhone X.
Lumentum's results indicate that iPhone X demand is healthy, Gene Munster, Loup Ventures managing partner, said in a blog post.
Lumentum in the December quarter reported 3D sensing revenue of about $200 million vs. $40 million in the September quarter, Munster wrote.
"Due to seasonality, the company expects 3D sensing revenue to be down 60% to 65% in the March quarter, which would imply 3D sensing revenue of $121 million to $125 million," he said. "But most importantly, management indicated 3D sensing revenue should 'more than double' in the second half 2018 over 2017, which we believe a high percentage of these orders will be going into current and new Apple (devices) this fall."
Lumentum shares jumped 21.2% to 51.65 on the stock market today .
Lumentum said its fiscal Q2 earnings were $1.67 a share, including a tax credit and other adjustments, with revenue rising 52% to $404.6 million. A year earlier, Lumentum earned 57 cents a share on sales of $265 million. Analysts expected Lumentum to earn $1.14 a share on sales of $356 million for the period ended Dec. 31.
For the March quarter, Lumentum forecast EPS of 72 to 73 cents at its midpoint of guidance vs. estimates of 88 cents. Lumentum said it expects revenue in a range of $292 million to $293 million vs. estimates of $311 million.
Lumentum said it had a tax credit of $207 million in Q2 as well as a $83 million write-down of deferred tax assets.
